items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you meet Hussein, King Hussein? [INTERVIEWEE] He was over here at the time.

ctx.x: And Pearl Bailey, she's quite a favorite in Jordan. She's very -- she was a good queen -- good friend of Queen Alia and King Hussein too because she's performed over there. And then we went to another place -- I can't remember where it was -- but this ambassador had been trying to give a luncheon for all the diplomats. Nobody -- they would just ignore the invitation, you know, and he gave a luncheon and he expected none of them to come, you know. All of them came.
